ctor.rationale: `base(3, CardType.Power, CardRarity.Rare, TargetType.Self)` (Calamity.cs:11-14) == cost 3 / POWER / RARE / SELF. No keywords, no CanonicalVars (the power amount is the literal 1).

OnPlay.rationale: `PowerCmd.Apply<CalamityPower>(choiceContext, Owner.Creature, 1m, Owner.Creature, this)` (Calamity.cs:18) == `PowerCmd.apply(ctx.hooks, ctx.player, CalamityPower, 1, applier=ctx.player)`. No animation trigger on either side. CalamityPower's add-a-random-Attack behaviour belongs to the power stream.

OnUpgrade.rationale: `EnergyCost.UpgradeBy(-1)` (Calamity.cs:23) == `self._energy_cost = max(0, self._energy_cost - 1)` (3 -> 2). Downgrade-safe; `card_probes.py downgrade` does not list calamity.
